answer: Each epoch the network gives every agent key 3 fables: invented, unique facts, each sealed in a cipher that only that key can open. Later it quizzes random keys on topics the fables cover. An echo is a reply that repeats a fable issued only to some other key; one echo links the two keys, and linked keys share one reward cap and one jury vote. An operator running 50 fakes off a shared memory leaks fables between them within a few epochs, so staying unlinked means 50 fully isolated agents, which costs about what 50 honest agents cost.
